ओह गॉड! कम उम्र में मां बनने पर मीरा राजपूत का छलका दर्द, जानिए क्या कुछ कहा! 😱✨

करीना कपूर के चैट शो What Women Want में मीरा राजपूत पहुंचीं।
उन्होंने बताया कि साल 2015 में 21 साल की उम्र में उन्होंने शादी की और 2016 में बेटी Misha को जन्म दिया।
मीरा का कहना है कि कम उम्र में motherhood अपनाना एक बड़ा चैलेंज था।
इस मुश्किल समय में उनके पति Shahid Kapoor बहुत सपोर्टिव रहे और उनकी दो बहनों ने भी मदद की।
मीरा ने बताया कि जब Misha 21 साल की होगी, तब वह खुद सिर्फ 41 साल की होंगी और बच्चों के साथ उनका बॉन्ड बहुत शानदार है।
आपको क्या लगता है, कम उम्र में पैरेंट बनना सही है या नहीं? 💭👇

#MiraRajput #KareenaKapoor #ShahidKapoor #BollywoodGossip #CineChaska #WhatWomenWant

ctx.title: Mira Rajput tells Kareena Kapoor that embracing motherhood at the age of 21 had its challenges but Shahid Kapoor was extremely supportive
ctx.summary: Mira Rajput was 21 years old when she welcomed her first child, a daughter named Misha, in August 2016. She then gave birth to son Zain in 2018.
ctx.text:
Shahid Kapoor married Mira Rajput when she was 21 in 2015. In 2016, they became parents when Mira gave birth to a daughter named Misha. Mira has now opened up about embracing motherhood at such an young age as she appeared on the chat show, What Women Want, hosted by Kareena Kapoor .
During the chat, Kareena asked whether Mira would want to do it any other way, to which Mira replied, “I don't think so. Regardless of what stage it comes to you, motherhood is a challenge. You and I have had kids in different stages but I am sure we both have had those challenges. With raising children, feeling overwhelmed, and I think at that time what helped me was that I had Shahid who was extremely supportive. I had my two sisters who had already had kids. I didn't read a single book because I saw them raising children. Ofcourse it had challenges but I would not have it any other way.”
Mira went on to add that she has a great time with her kids and understands their way of communication. She said that she likes the fact that she can have a great time with her kids and that she will be 41 when Misha will be 21.
Shahid and Mira had an arranged marriage in 2015, when Mira was 21 years old. The two met because they follow the same spiritual path. They have two children – daughter Misha and son Zain. Mira recently co-founded skincare brand Akind Beauty with Tira Beauty.
Kareena and Shahid dated for about four years from 2004-2007. In 2012, she married Saif Ali Khan and Shahid married Mira in 2015.
Meanwhile, on the acting front, Kareena was recently seen headlining investigative drama Daayra . The film stars Kareena and Prithviraj Sukumaran as cops who face off while navigating the dark and complex world of juvenile crime.
